name: AIOMetadata
description: AIOMetadata is a Stremio metadata addon. Redis is required for caching; SQLite (default) or PostgreSQL for storage. Most options (API keys, providers, catalogs, passwords) are set in the /configure web UI and stored in the database—not as container variables.

paths.name: Data Folder
paths.description: Persistent addon data (SQLite DB when using default DATABASE_URI).

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Host port mapped to the addon (container listens on 3232).

variables.name: Host Name
variables.description: Public URL where the addon is reachable (include https://). Used for manifest and resource URLs.

variables.name: Database URI
variables.description: SQLite default matches the Data Folder mount. Use postgresql://... for Postgres.

variables.name: Redis URL
variables.description: Redis URL for caching. Change host if your Redis container is not named redis.
